concept: First-person mirror outfit check showcasing embroidered lawn suit details

scenes.visual: Woman in full-length mirror holding phone up, wearing the embroidered green lawn suit, full head-to-toe view in modern bedroom
scenes.background: Elegant modern bedroom with large mirror, warm natural light streaming through windows, minimalist decor
scenes.vo: Yaar this embroidered lawn suit is absolutely gorgeous

scenes.visual: Same woman turning to three-quarter angle in mirror, phone still raised, showing the side silhouette and drape of the suit
scenes.background: Same elegant bedroom mirror setup, soft diffused lighting from the side
scenes.vo: Dekho na the drape aur fit kitna perfect hai

scenes.visual: Closer waist-up shot of woman in mirror focusing on the intricate embroidery work and neckline details, phone visible
scenes.background: Close-up mirror reflection with warm bedroom lighting highlighting fabric texture
scenes.vo: Embroidery work dekho kitna detailed aur beautiful hai yaar

scenes.visual: Woman looking directly at camera through mirror with confident smile, phone held up, full outfit visible with dupatta
scenes.background: Mirror reflection with soft bedroom ambiance, golden hour lighting
scenes.vo: Main toh completely obsessed hun with this whole look

scenes.visual: Final confident pose in mirror, woman adjusting dupatta with one hand while holding phone, complete outfit showcase
scenes.background: Bright modern bedroom mirror with perfect lighting showcasing the entire ensemble
scenes.vo: Tumhe bhi pasand aaya toh The Collection se shop karo abhi

notes: Authentic outfit check format with same woman throughout, showcasing the embroidered lawn suit from multiple angles in a natural mirror selfie style. Each scene builds the story from full reveal to detailed embroidery work to confident final pose with clear CTA.
